milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find anvil' is a locate/observe task — the player must navigate through the stone brick workshop and get close enough to the anvil to visually identify it. The anvil is placed at spawn-relative [7, 0, 7] in the far corner of the room. max_distance=16 allows detection from across the room (room is ~16 blocks wide), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the anvil, not just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because crafting golden leggings places the item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 7 gold ingots and no golden_leggings, so detecting min_count=1 golden_leggings in inventory is a reliable and deterministic signal that the crafting was completed successfully. No golden_leggings exist in the starting inventory or scene, so there are no false positives.
